method: Walked /photography/analytics against the local dev server at 390, 920, and 1280 pixels after separating album opens from photo opens. Verified the Photo Opens headline, Photo Open Sources panel, popular-photo open badges, and Album Reach labels with live aggregate data. The table shows engaged visitors, album opens, photo opens, downloads, favorites, shares, and last activity as separate units. At 1280 and 920 pixels the table fits its container; at 390 pixels it scrolls inside its own container while document scrollWidth equals clientWidth. The stat cards reflow to one column at 390 pixels.
scope: Album Reach metric split and table overflow
